description:
Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-exceptions.html, decision 4, ticket 4. Blocked by fz-sc8.77 (a struct carries __struct__ at runtime).

Build: defexception fields -> a struct with __exception__: true, overridable message/1 (when there is a message field) and exception/1 (binary -> message:, list -> struct!). raise Mod -> Mod.exception([]); raise Mod, attrs -> Mod.exception(attrs); raise of a value that is neither binary, atom nor exception struct raises ArgumentError with Elixir's text. Exception.message/1 calls the module's message/1. is_exception/1 guard.

Acceptance (interp, run, build; elixir oracle):
- defexception with a message field: raise Mod, message: "x" rescued by alias, e.message is "x"; default message when raised bare.
- custom message/1 used by the uncaught line (`** (Mod) <custom>`) and by Exception.message/1.
- raise Mod, attrs builds the struct through exception/1; a user-defined exception/1 is honoured.
- raise 42 -> ArgumentError "raise/1 and reraise/2 expect a module name, string or exception as the first argument, got: 42".
- is_exception/1 true for a raised struct, false for a plain map with __struct__ only.
- exceptions doc gains the struct section; guides updated if they mention exceptions.
- gate green as in the epic.
title: defexception, raise Mod, attrs and Exception.message/1
